summary: Registered SYN.A market maker re-quoting a SELL 5322 / BUY 1064 pair roughly every 3s, cancelling both together and re-pricing with the touch. The SELL executions the detector read as opposite-side fills were fills on the trader's own resting SELL quotes (17504 executed, 11% of submitted). There was no BUY execution (opposite_side_fill_qty 0), so no benefit and no price move. Feature (a) is absent because the orders were working quotes. Feature (b) is absent. Close as market making.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric bid/ask pair of 321 every 1-10s. The only fills (92 and 44) were on its own resting BUY quote. There was no opposite-side execution, so no benefit. Resting size is 0.13x depth, 0.2 tick from the touch. The detector's 'BUY execution' is the fill on the trader's own bid. Closing as market making.

AGENCY trader worked a 21768 ICEBERG BUY (parent C-T-X1005-05-A) at 10002. It executed 5835 (27% of submitted) before the only SELL, a 544 LIMIT under a different parent (C-T-X1005-05-B), so the SELL is a different client's order and not a round trip. The remainder was cancelled after the SELL. Feature (a) is absent because the order was working and hidden. Feature (b) is not shown. No repetition, no prior alerts.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting a symmetric 391-lot bid/ask pair, re-priced every 1-13s around the mid. The only execution was a 58-lot partial fill on its own bid. There was no opposite-side execution, no size relative to depth, and no benefit. The detector fired on gross submitted size from quote refreshes. Closing as market making.

PROP trader placed one BUY limit of 38,461 (15.7x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks off the touch, no fills. 2.5s later a 1,423 SELL market order executed; the BUY was cancelled 360 ms after. Price moved 0.5 tick in the trader's favour before the sale and reverted 1.0 tick after the cancel. No supported legitimate explanation. Single cycle, so ESCALATE rather than STOR draft.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 366 (desk typical 327, ~0.15x depth), re-priced every 1-4s following the touch. Cancel symmetry 0.98. The only executions (441) were on its own BUY quotes; no opposite-side execution, so no benefit. The detector's 'BUY execution' trigger is a fill on its own resting bid. Core features (a) and (b) are absent.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A quoted a symmetric two-sided 391 lot bid/ask and re-quoted every few seconds. The detector's gross BUY size is the sum of these refreshes. Resting size was 0.16x depth, the cancels were symmetric across sides, and there was no favourable price move or reversion. The two SELL fills (126 and 118) were fills on its own ask quote. Both core features are absent.

PROP-EQ trader placed a single one-sided BUY of 27326 (11.15x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, then 2.2s later sold 640 by market order. The touch rose and then fell back after the cancel. Fills on the BUY (4707) came only after the sale, and the remaining 22619 was cancelled. No registered MM status, no event, no risk event. This is the escalation pattern for a spoofer caught in the book. It happened once, so I do not propose a STOR draft.

T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at 356 per order, refreshed every 1-6 s. Cancels are near-symmetric and the resting size is about 15% of depth. The alerted SELL fills were on its own resting ask. There was no favourable price move and no reversion. Closing as market making.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size of 2464, re-pricing every ~2s. Cancels are symmetric (0.963), resting size is about 1x depth, and the bid was executing on its own quote before any sell. There was no favourable price move, no reversion, a negative round trip and no repetition of a one-sided cycle. The detector fired on gross two-sided quote churn. Both core features are absent.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at a constant 356 and re-quoted about every 1-6s. Sizes are about 0.15x depth and close to the desk's typical size. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99). The three fills were on its own quotes. The price moved against the trader (-1 tick) with no reversion, so there is no benefit. Core features (a) and (b) are absent. Proposed CLOSE_FP.

Single BUY 18930 at 9997 (7.9x top-5 depth), cancelled after about 0.8s. 1 tick behind the touch. No fills either side, so no opposite-side execution and no benefit. 0.4s after the cancel the trader re-entered the same side, price and 1/10 of the size (1893), which looks like a size entry error that was corrected. No repetition, no prior alerts. Proposed close as fat finger; this rests on the corrected order, not on size.

ALGO-EXEC trader T-X1012-02 ran a two-sided pegged execution algo on SYN.A. All 76 orders are PEGGED children of two parents (P-T-X1012-02-B and -S), at typical size 2424, at the touch, and re-priced on both sides in step with the touch. Cancels are symmetric (0.996). The executions were small partial fills on both sides. There was no favourable move that reverted and no one-sided large resting order, so the detector fired on the algo's routine re-pricing. I propose closing as a false positive.

Five BUY limit orders of 4340 each (21700 total, 8.7x avg top-5 depth) were placed on five levels 1-5 ticks below the touch within 60 ms. Two seconds later the trader sold 799 by market order at a bid that had risen 2 ticks. All five bids were cancelled within about 0.3-0.9 s after the sale. None of the bids executed, and the price then reverted 2 ticks. This is one-sided, with no supported legitimate explanation. Both core features are present. It is a single cycle, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 rather than DRAFT_STOR.

PROP trader placed a single one-sided SELL limit of 21443 (8.2x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, then bought 1189 by market order 2.4s later and cancelled the whole SELL 363 ms after the buy. No fills on the SELL, no market-making registration, no event, no risk event, no parent/peg. Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is unproven: price_move_ticks is 0 and there was no reversion after cancel, so the buy shows no clear favourable move. Repetitions in session = 3. No legitimate explanation is supported, so escalate to Level 2. This is not a STOR draft proposal because the benefit is unclear.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoting both sides at its typical 3302 size, re-quoting every 2-3s. Cancels are symmetric (0.966). The resting orders were trading: 898 filled on the quoting side, 184 of it before any opposite-side fill. There was no favourable price move and no reversion. No news or risk event. Detector triggered on size and quote refresh only.

ALGO-EXEC trader quoting both sides with PEGGED child orders of two parents (P-T-X1015-06-B/-S), 1984 each (typical size). Cancels are symmetric and re-peg to the touch; orders sit at the touch and are under one depth. The positive round trip is two-sided spread income, not a benefit from a one-sided resting order. No risk event. Detector fired on gross size and cancel-after-fill, which is normal for a re-pricing algo.

PROP trader placed two BUY limits of 7,215 each (14,430 total, 5.5x avg top-5 depth) at one level 1.5 ticks off the touch, with no fills. About 28s later a SELL of 515 filled at 10001 while the bid had risen 1.5 ticks. Both BUYs were cancelled 2.6s after the sell, 142ms after an unscheduled news item. After the cancel the price fell 2 ticks. The news reaction is plausible but not established: the sell came before the news and the orders had rested for about 30s. Evidence is mixed, so I propose escalation to Level 2.

BUY 11565 at 10003 (4.6x depth) was working: 2774 executed on it before the trader's single 346 SELL, i.e. 24% of submitted and far more than the opposite qty. Policy treats this as a genuine working order (feature a absent); the smaller sell and later reduction of the remainder are ordinary order management. No repetition, no news, no prior alerts. Price move of +1.5 ticks and round trip +2 are noted, but no reversion is observed and the policy says not feature (b) when the order was working.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at constant size 395 (desk typical 317), re-pricing every 1-6s. Cancels are symmetric across sides. The BUY fill of 46 that triggered the detector was on the trader's own resting bid. There was no opposite-side execution, no favourable price move and no repetition of a spoof cycle. Closed as market making.

Prop trader placed five SELL limit orders of 4734 each (23670 total, up to 9.4x avg top-5 depth) across 4 price levels 3 ticks from the touch, then bought 624 via market order at 12:38:36.111 as the ask rose, then cancelled all five SELL orders within about 1-1.5s (215 ms after the buy). No sell fills, cancel symmetry 0, no registered MM, no risk event, no news, no pegged/parent orders. Both core features appear present and no legitimate explanation is supported. Single cycle in the session, so I propose Level 2 review rather than a STOR draft.

A single BUY of 23620 (9.5x top-5 depth) at 9996, one tick behind the bid, was cancelled after about 1 s. 400 ms later the trader entered a BUY of 2362 at the same price, exactly one tenth of the size, which looks like a decimal-place entry error corrected. There was no opposite-side execution, no price benefit, no repetition and no prior alerts. Feature (b) is absent. Feature (a) is not established because the entry-error explanation is supported by the tape. Proposed close as fat finger.

Prop trader placed a BUY of 19570 at 9996 (about 8x top-5 depth). It executed 3568 (18% of the order) in two partial fills BEFORE the trader's only SELL of 587 at 9999, so the order was working. The SELL was smaller than the prior same-side fills. The remainder was then reduced by MODIFY. Under section 6.2 this is genuine execution and ordinary order management, so feature (a) is absent and (b) is not established. Residual doubt: the order was large, one-sided, and the price moved +2 ticks before the sell, so L2 may want to review.

Registered SYN.A market maker T-MM-02 quoting 335 on both bid and ask, re-pricing every 1-6s. The detector fired on gross BUY size and a SELL fill with a BUY cancel. Cancels are symmetric across sides, size is typical and small relative to depth, and the price did not move for the trader. No one-sided resting order and no benefit, so the pattern is ordinary market making.

PROP trader bought 1254 at market (10005), then placed three one-sided BUY limits of 4514 each (13542 total, 5.4x top-5 depth, 6 ticks from touch), none filled. 20s later sold 1254 at market (700 filled at 10001-9999), and the three bids were cancelled 600 ms after. Feature (a) looks present (large, away, one-sided, never executed, 100% cancelled). Feature (b) is not shown: price moved against the trader (-1.5 ticks), no reversion, round trip -4.77 ticks. No legitimate explanation is supported (not an MM, no parent/pegged orders, no risk event, no public event). Evidence is mixed with no supported explanation, so escalate to Level 2.

Algo trader placed one SELL LIMIT of 20314 (8.3x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, then sent a BUY MARKET of 1130 about 1.8s later and cancelled the whole SELL 127ms after the buy. The sell was one-sided (cancel_symmetry 0), had no fills and no parent order. None of the accepted explanations is supported. Prior closures relied on pegged/parent/symmetric cancels, and none of that holds today. The favourable move is small and the buy partly swept up to the trader's own sell level, so DRAFT_STOR is not proposed: this is a single cycle. The evidence is mixed, so it goes to Level 2.

Agency trader's 17528 BUY ICEBERG order at the touch (parent C-T-X1028-06-A) was working: 2990 filled before the only opposite-side trade, a 438 SELL under a different parent (C-T-X1028-06-B), i.e. a different client's order. No favourable price move and no reversion. No repetition. Resting size is hidden iceberg total, not displayed size. Closing as a false positive.

Trader placed a single one-sided SELL limit of 31,395 (12.9x avg top-5 depth) 3 ticks from the touch, bought 1,053 by market order 2.8s later, and cancelled the whole SELL 158 ms after the buy. No same-side fills, no registered MM on SYN.A, no event, no risk event. Price moved +0.5 ticks for the trader and reverted 2.5 ticks after the cancel. Both core features appear present and no legitimate explanation is supported. Single occurrence, so no STOR draft proposed; Level 2 to review.

Pegged execution algo (ALGO-EXEC) re-pricing paired BUY/SELL child orders of two parents at the touch. Cancels are symmetric across sides, size is about 1x depth, and the BUY orders executed 6657 before the single opposite-side SELL fill (1118). The price moved against the trader with no reversion. Neither core feature is present and algorithmic re-pricing is supported.

Three BUY limit orders of 5152 (15456 total, 6.1x top-5 depth) rested 2 ticks from the touch. A 772 SELL filled at 10006 at 13:35:36.550. At 13:35:37.550 all three BUYs were cancelled in the same instant as a recorded automated kill switch (intraday loss limit breached). The SELL fill had no favourable price move (price_move_ticks 0.0) and no reversion (0.0), so feature (b) is absent. The kill switch gives the cancel a purpose other than moving price. Mixed points: size is far above the typical 500, the orders were one-sided, and the cancels came 1 s after the sell fill. Proposed close with moderate confidence.
